alternatives_considered: BET (donk): rejected — OOP 3-way vs PFA is the worst spot to donk; capped range gets raised off equity by CO, and we lose value from CO's air c-bets.
CHECK-intending-fold: rejected — hand has SDV and 69% equity; we defend vs one c-bet.
